focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h1>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">接手一个陌生项目时，最花时间的往往不是写代码，而是搞清楚这个项目是干什么的、主流程怎么跑、模块之间怎么衔接。<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">Wiki</strong> 就是让 ZCode 读一遍代码库，把这些整理成一份可以随时查阅的文档。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">它的定位是 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">代码库架构导读</strong>，不是产品文档站或使用手册。目录会优先覆盖项目身份、主执行链路、核心模块与子模块、跨端边界、数据与状态流、配置边界、扩展点和风险点，而不是「安装部署」「CI/CD」这类通用栏目。所有结论都带源码位置，可以点击跳回对应文件。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Wiki 会在当前工作区所在的运行环境中扫描代码并保存生成结果，一个工作区一份。生成目录和正文时，ZCode 会将经过安全规则过滤、按需读取的代码上下文发送给你选择的模型服务。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="generate">生成<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">在工作区文件树顶部、仓库名称右侧点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">仓库 Wiki</strong> 图标进入，它会占据整个主工作区。还没生成过时，中间是一张状态卡，生成前可以配置四项：</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260801-repo-wiki/wiki-entry-annotated.webp" alt="工作区文件树顶部、仓库名称右侧的仓库 Wiki 图标入口" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<blockquote class="border-l-4 border-border bg-muted/5 px-4 py-2 italic text-muted-foreground mb-4">
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">找不到入口？</strong> Wiki 图标在<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">文件树面板</strong>内部（各平台一致，包括 Windows）。如果没看到，先打开文件树：把鼠标悬停在左侧边栏的工作区条目上，点击出现的文件树按钮展开面板，图标就在顶部仓库名的右侧。远程工作区断开连接、或工作区处于只读状态时，不会显示该入口。</p>
</blockquote>
<div class="mb-6 overflow-x-auto rounded-md border border-border bg-card"><table class="min-w-full border-collapse text-sm"><thead class="bg-muted/60 text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.1em] text-muted-foreground"><tr class="bg-transparent"><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">选项</th><th class="border-b border-border px-4 py-3 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground" style="text-align:left">说明</th></tr></thead><tbody class="bg-card"><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">语言</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">简体中文或英文，默认跟随界面语言</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">模型</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认用当前工作区的聊天模型。可以临时换一个，不影响聊天设置</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">生成图表</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">默认开启。开启后会在图确实能帮助理解、且有源码依据的地方生成架构图、流程图、时序图或状态图</td></tr><tr class="bg-transparent"><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重试次数</strong></td><td class="border-t border-border px-4 py-3 align-top text-sm text-foreground" style="text-align:left">单个页面生成失败时自动重试几次，默认不重试</td></tr></tbody></table></div>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">点 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">生成 Wiki</strong> 后，状态条会依次显示 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">正在分析代码库 → 正在生成目录 → 正在生成页面 → 正在保存 Wiki</strong>。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">目录生成后即可开始阅读：已完成的页面会立即开放，尚未生成的页面会在目录中显示等待状态。生成过程中可以随时点击 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">停止</strong>，已完成的页面会保留下来，之后仍可重新生成或删除。如果部分页面生成失败，目录区域会显示失败数量。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260801-repo-wiki/wiki-generating-annotated.webp" alt="生成中的 Wiki：顶部进度显示 5/12，右上角可随时停止，目录里已完成的页面可点开，未轮到的显示「正在生成」与「等待生成」" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="read">阅读<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">界面分两栏：左侧是已打开的项目列表，展开某个项目就能看到它的目录树；右侧是正文。中间的分隔线可以拖动调整宽度，项目列表也可以整个收起；窗口或面板较窄时会自动改成上下堆叠。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">顶部显示当前仓库名，下方的 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">元数据</strong> 展开后能看到分支、语言、更新时间、提交 ID 和 Wiki 文件数——用来确认这份 Wiki 对应的是哪个版本的代码。</p>
<p class="flex gap-4 text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><img src="/content/docs/v2/screenshots/20260801-repo-wiki/wiki-reading-annotated.webp" alt="Wiki 阅读视图：左侧目录树、右侧正文，顶部元数据展开后显示分支、语言、更新时间、提交 ID 与 Wiki 文件数" class="flex-1 rounded-lg border border-white/10 mb-4 block min-w-0 max-w-full cursor-zoom-in transition-opacity hover:opacity-90"/></p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">正文里的每个结论都标注了 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">源码位置</strong>，格式是文件路径加行号区间，点击直接跳到工作区里对应的文件和行。开启图表后生成的 Mermaid 图支持主题适配、缩放和放大预览，单张图渲染失败不会影响正文阅读。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="refresh">保持更新<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Wiki 不需要你记得手动更新。每轮对话结束时，如果这个仓库已经有 Wiki，ZCode 会检查代码是否真的变了——变了才触发刷新，没变直接跳过。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">需要主动重来时，顶部工具栏有 <strong class="font-medium text-foreground">重新生成</strong>。它默认沿用上次的模型，也可以为这一次临时换一个。</p>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">删除 Wiki</strong> 只清理本地内容，随时可以重新生成。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="storage">生成结果存在哪里<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">Wiki 的生成结果保存在本机用户数据目录，<strong class="font-medium text-foreground">不写入仓库</strong>：</p>
<pre class="rounded-lg bg-muted/60 mt-2 mb-4 p-4 overflow-auto border border-border"><code class="block text-foreground font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed language-txt">~/.zcode/v2/repo-wiki/&lt;工作区标识哈希&gt;/wiki.json
</code></pre>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">wiki.json</code> 是纯 JSON 文件，包含全部页面的 Markdown 正文与源码引用（Windows 上位于 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">C:\Users\&lt;用户名&gt;\.zcode\v2\repo-wiki\</code> 下）。想让 Agent 直接读取生成结果，把这个文件路径提供给它即可。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="troubleshooting">生成失败排查<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">「Wiki 模型请求超时（180000ms）」</strong>：单次模型请求有 3 分钟的固定上限（不可配置），网络慢或模型服务响应慢时会触发。换用响应更快的模型或稍后重试。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">「模型响应缺少文本内容」</strong>：常见于第三方部署的模型。Wiki 要求模型把正文放在所选 API 协议的标准文本字段返回；如果模型把内容放进思考字段、返回分块结构、或供应商配置的 API 协议与服务实际协议不一致，就会触发这个错误。建议确认供应商的 API 协议选择正确（目录与页面的工具化生成目前只支持 OpenAI Chat Completions 协议），或换用官方渠道模型。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">单页失败不影响整体</strong>：某一页重试耗尽后会计入失败数并继续生成其余页面，只有全部页面失败时任务才整体失败。「重试次数」默认为 0，生成不稳定时可调到 2~3。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">生成中途退出应用</strong>：任务会在下次打开时标记为已停止，已完成的页面保留，可重新生成。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="privacy">它会读哪些文件<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">生成时 ZCode 只读当前工作区内的文件，并且用的是 Wiki 专用的阅读视图，与其他功能的文件扫描相互独立。以下内容不会进入用于生成 Wiki 的模型上下文：</p>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.git</code> 目录、依赖目录、构建产物、缓存和本地运行状态文件；</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">根目录 <code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">.gitignore</code> 中符合支持范围的忽略规则所排除的内容；</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">文件名中包含 token、secret、credential、password 等敏感词的疑似密钥或配置文件（<code class="rounded-md bg-muted text-foreground border border-border px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-sm">tokenService.ts</code> 这类正常源码不受影响）；</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">符号链接指向的文件和目录。</li>
</ul>
<p class="text-base leading-relaxed mb-4 last:mb-0">模型不会拿到一份预先准备好的文件清单，而是自己按目录逐层展开、按需读取，读取范围始终受上面这些规则约束。</p>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="limits">限制<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>
<ul class="mb-4 list-disc list-outside pl-5 text-sm">
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">同一个仓库同时只能跑一个生成任务。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50"><strong class="font-medium text-foreground">同一个仓库只保留一个语言版本。</strong> 换语言重新生成会覆盖原来的，中英文不能并存。</li>
<li class="ps-1 mb-2 marker:text-muted-foreground/50">不支持单页重新生成，也不保留历史版本。</li>
</ul>
<hr class="my-8 border-t border-border"/>
<h2 class="group min-w-0 text-3xl font-medium mt-12 mb-4 text-foreground" id="next-steps">下一步<button type="button" aria-label="Copy link" title="Copy link" class="ml-3 inline-flex size-8 items-center justify-center rounded-md border border-transparent text-muted-foreground/60 transition hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/40 hover:border-border opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus-visible:opacity-100 cursor-pointer"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="24" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="lucide lucide-link2 lucide-link-2 size-4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M9 17H7A5 5 0 0 1 7 7h2"></path><path d="M15 7h2a5 5 0 1 1 0 10h-2"></path><line x1="8" x2="16" y1="12" y2="12"></line></svg></button></h2>

transition-all hover:bg-neutral-800/50 hover:border-white/20" href="/cn/docs/task-management"><div class="flex items-center gap-2"><h4 class="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground group-hover:text-sky-400 transition-colors">任务与文件管理</h4></div><p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">用文件树浏览文件、查看变更并引用进对话。</p></a><a class="group relative flex flex-col gap-2 rounded-lg text-foreground group-hover:text-sky-400 transition-colors">ZCode Agent</h4></div><p class="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">了解 Agent 的上下文补充与执行模式。</p></a></div></article><aside
